description_short: The Town of Warren's summer day camp at Burr's Hill Park for ages 5-14, 9 am to 3 pm on weekdays from late June to mid-August, with extended hours from 7 am to 5 pm. An electronics-free camp with arts and crafts, games, bowling, weekly contests, swimming at the town beach, performances and field trips, and a free summer lunch program.
